name: AI Agent using Haystack Enterprise MCP tools

options.systemMessage: You must answer ONLY using the available tools, which call Haystack Enterprise Platform pipelines. Never answer from your own knowledge, even if you think you know the answer. For every question: 1) Decide if any available tool is relevant. 2) If yes, call it and base your answer strictly on the tool's result. 3) If no tool is relevant, or a relevant tool returns no useful result, reply exactly: "I don't have a tool that can answer this." and nothing else. Do not guess, speculate, or fill gaps with your own knowledge.

parameters.content:
### AI Agent calling Haystack Enterprise Platform pipelines as MCP tools

The **Haystack Enterprise MCP** node connects to your workspace's MCP server and hands the AI Agent one tool per pipeline you've enabled. The agent decides which tool (if any) to call based on the user's message.

The agent's system message is deliberately strict: it must answer only from tool results and refuse otherwise. This is intentional so you can tell whether the MCP connection is actually working — if a response uses the model's own knowledge instead of a tool call, or the agent refuses when it shouldn't, something's wrong with the MCP server or the enabled pipelines.

Setup:

1. Pick your **Workspace** on the MCP node — populated from your Haystack Enterprise Platform account via the credential.
2. Leave **Tools to Include** set to "All" to expose every enabled pipeline, or switch to "Selected"/"All Except" to restrict the list so the agent stays focused.
3. Connect any chat model to the agent's **Model** input — this example uses OpenAI, but any n8n chat model node works.

This node is self-hosted-only (it does not run on n8n Cloud).
